data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'nazg', meaning 'noble, radiant'. The name Nazgul is a feminine form and is associated with victory and success. It is a name of great esteem and respect in Persian, Arabic, and Urdu cultures. The name Nazgul carries the meaning “Noble, Radiant, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
